sentences.text: Author: Joymalya Bagchi Bench: Joymalya Bagchi  IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA
In Re : Sujit Sarkar .....petitioner  Mr. Shibaji Kumar Das  Mr. Dipendu Sarkar  Ms. Deblina De  ....... for the petitioner

1. 
Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits he was married to one Karabi Sarkar on 11th December,
1988 and he never resided with opposite party no. 2 as husband and wife.

2. Allegations in the charge-sheet require to be considered in the light of the aforesaid submission to determine whether ingredients of offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code are disclosed against the petitioner.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon opposite party 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor,
High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.

4. Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" four weeks after Puja Vacation.
5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceedings G.R. No. 10010 of 2023 arising out of Jetia Police Station Case No. 227 of 2023 dated 13th December, 2023 which culminated in charge sheet no. 24 of 2024 dated 24th February, 2024 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code pending CRR/3669/2024 on 5 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57382835/
1 before the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 4th Court at Barrackpore, North 24 Pargans for a period of six weeks after Puja Vacation or until further orders whichever is earlier.
